title: Where the photos live
question: Which storage should the cloud library use?
context: About 2 TB to start, growing by 50 GB a month. Reads matter more than writes: every thumbnail and every edit opens a file.

criteria.name: How hard it is to leave

options.name: Amazon S3
options.summary: The standard, with every tool built for it.
pros: Every library and tool supports it
Lifecycle rules move old photos to cheaper storage
cons: Paying to read files out adds up with thumbnails

scores.criterion: How hard it is to leave

options.name: Cloudflare R2
options.summary: Speaks S3's language, and reading files out is free.

scores.criterion: How hard it is to leave

options.name: A machine of our own
options.summary: A storage server in a rack we rent.
cons: Backups, disks and outages are ours
options.cost: about $1,800 up front, then $40 a month

scores.criterion: How hard it is to leave

recommendation.why: the cheapest at our size because thumbnails read so much, with the same code as S3, so leaving stays easy.
